business_summary: Aries Agro Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacturing and sale of micronutrients and other nutritional products for plants and animals. The company offers micronutrients, water soluble NPK, organic and bio products, high density inputs, crop specific, slow release fertilizers pastilles, plant protection, aqua culture and animal nutrition, urban products, and other products. It also provides various crops, such as sugarcane, grape, coffee, cotton, potato, cauliflower, citrus, cashew nut, papaya, wheat, cocoa, paddy, turmeric, elephant yam, oil palm, black gram, tomato, pomegranate, rose, mango, maize, onion, ginger, chilli, banana, watermelon, and groundnut. In addition, the company is involved in farm equipment and machinery, and mineral feed supplements businesses; and trading of plant nutrients. It has operations in India, Australia, New Zealand, Nigeria, Nepal, the Philippines, Taiwan, the United Arab Emirates, Sri Lanka, Saudi Arabia, Mozambique, Uzbekistan, Bangladesh, Mauritius, and internationally. Aries Agro Limited was incorporated in 1969 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.
